text: That morning: Helen explains why they locked their doors
why: The conversation takes place that morning, and Helen explains the locked doors in the story so far (¶48).

text: Why did the sisters always lock themselves in at night? — to keep out the cheetah and the baboon
id: q.why_locked=to keep out the cheetah and the baboon
why: Helen states this reason directly: the Doctor kept a cheetah and a baboon, and they felt no security unless their doors were locked (¶48).

text: Why did the sisters always lock themselves in at night? — to keep out their stepfather
why: The story has established the stepfather's violent temper and uncontrollable anger (¶26-27), so a reader has reason to consider him as a reason for the locked doors. The story has not confirmed it, but it is a plain possibility.
